Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

  • You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

  • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

Optimize the execution and serving of modern AI models on Arago's custom accelerator. Work across kernels, model execution, multi-device distribution, runtime, and inference serving, while helping shape the software stack around the capabilities of Arago's hardware.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in high-performance ML inference, GPU/accelerator programming, or ML systems engineering.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, accelerator/GPU execution models, memory hierarchies, parallelism, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience developing and optimizing custom kernels using CUDA, Triton, ROCm/HIP, or equivalent low-level programming environments.

  • Experience with operator fusion, tiling, scheduling, data movement optimization, graph execution, and profiling of compute- and memory-bound workloads.

  • Strong understanding of distributed model execution, including tensor, pipeline, sequence, and/or expert parallelism and communication/computation overlap.

  • Hands-on experience with modern inference-serving systems such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent, including KV-cache management, continuous batching, paged attention, and prefill/decode scheduling.

  • Strong C++ and Python skills, and comfort working on a custom accelerator stack where compiler, runtime, kernels, and abstractions are actively being developed. Exposure to or experience with MLIR and MLIR dialects is a strong plus.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze modern AI workloads and identify kernel-, runtime-, memory-, and system-level bottlenecks on Arago's accelerator.

  • Develop and optimize custom kernels, fused operators, and execution strategies to maximize device utilization.

  • Design efficient mappings of models and operators across multiple Arago devices, including communication and synchronization strategies.

  • Develop inference-serving techniques such as continuous batching, paged KV caches, prefix/context caching, chunked prefill, and prefill/decode interleaving or disaggregation.

  • Build profiling, benchmarking, and performance-analysis infrastructure spanning kernels, full models, and serving workloads.

  • Work closely with Arago's hardware, compiler, and runtime teams to co-design software abstractions and influence future hardware features based on real model workloads.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

As a Performance Software Engineer, you will be instrumental in building the core computation software that runs on Arago’s custom AI accelerators. Your work will bridge the gap between host systems and proprietary hardware, encompassing everything from a custom on-board kernels to the sophisticated tooling required for real-time debugging. You will be a key player in chip bring-up and the long-term development of high-performance computation primitives and kernels, ensuring our architecture operates with maximum efficiency and deterministic performance.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong experience in low-level systems programming using C/C++ and assembly, with excellent understanding of how compiled software maps to machine instructions and hardware behavior.

  • Deep familiarity with bare-metal development, including startup code, linker scripts, memory layout, MMIO, interrupts/exceptions, timers, synchronization, and direct peripheral access.

  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, including pipelines, caches, memory hierarchies, virtual/physical addressing, atomics, DMA, and performance implications of different access patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with RISC-V and/or ARM architectures, instruction sets, calling conventions, ABI concepts, and architecture-specific intrinsics.

  • Experience debugging hardware/software interactions using tools such as GDB, JTAG, trace/debug interfaces, simulators, emulators, or FPGA platforms.

  • Ability to read hardware specifications, register descriptions, and RTL-level documentation and translate them into robust software implementations.

  • Strong performance-analysis and optimization skills, including profiling, disassembly inspection, compiler optimization behavior, and hand-tuned assembly where appropriate.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize low-level software primitives in C/C++, assembly, and architecture-specific intrinsics, primarily for RISC-V and ARM platforms.

  • Implement performance-critical kernels, runtime components, hardware abstraction layers, drivers, and firmware operating in bare-metal or highly constrained environments.

  • Work closely with hardware architects and RTL/design teams to define and validate hardware-software interfaces, memory maps, register interfaces, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, and boot flows.

  • Analyze and optimize software for latency, throughput, memory footprint, instruction count, and efficient use of processor and accelerator features.

  • Bring up and debug software on simulation, emulation, FPGA, and silicon platforms, including low-level hardware/software integration issues.

  • Develop validation tests, benchmarks, and diagnostic tools for new processor, DSP, accelerator, and SoC functionality.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions around ISA extensions, compiler intrinsics, memory hierarchy, DMA, cache/coherency behavior, and software-visible hardware features.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 10 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

Our Hiring Process: Your Journey to Arago

  • Screening Call : Get to know you beyond your CV.

  • Technical meeting : Deep dive into your past projects and technical achievements.

  • CEO Interview : Assess the fit with the team’s culture and long-term vision.

  • Reference Calls: Mandatory calls with your former managers to validate strengths, weaknesses, and work style.

  • Technical Assessment: Take-home technical assignment crafted to the role you’re applying for.

  • Final Interview : Discuss your technical assignment and address any remaining questions with team members.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate analog and RF integrated circuits, including critical blocks such as amplifiers, mixers, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, and bias/reference circuits, with a focus on signal integrity, linearity, and precision.

  • Extensive experience in IC design and post-layout design methodology using standard industry tools like Cadence Virtuoso.

data.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

We span Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Business Partnering, and Workplace, and we work hand in hand with every team to make Joko efficient, scalable, and a place people genuinely love working at. We don't just run people processes — we design, challenge, and rethink them.

Today, Joko is 100+ people across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, and we are set to grow to 200+ within 18 months. That kind of growth only holds up if the office, the rituals, and the daily fabric of the company scale with it — which is where the Workplace Manager comes in.

🎯 What you will do

As Workplace Manager, your mission is to make Joko a place people genuinely love coming to every day, and to hold our culture together as we double in size. You will report to the VP People and partner closely with the rest of the People team, Finance, and Legal.

  • Own the Paris office end-to-end: Our Paris office is your canvas. You will manage service providers, supplies, and facilities, keep the space impeccable and organized, and be the first point of contact for anything office-related. You will also be the go-to resource for our remote teammates across France and abroad, so the experience of working at Joko feels consistent regardless of where people sit.

  • Bring the team together through events: From All Hands to Joko Academies, Team Events, Joko Drinks, offsites, and our legendary Christmas Party, you will design and run each gathering so it is not just well-organized, but a genuine moment of connection. As we grow into an international company, you will make sure our rituals scale with us and keep bringing the team together across geographies.

  • Own onboarding end-to-end: First impressions matter, and onboarding is one of the most consequential parts of the Joko experience. You will run the process from employment contract to IT setup to team introductions to custom Joko goodies, so every new hire lands seamlessly and feels welcome from day one.

  • Hold the culture as we scale: Doubling in size is precisely when a company culture can slip. The office you run, the events you design, and the way new joiners are welcomed are where Joko's culture gets rebuilt every day. You will be one of the people who keeps Joko Joko as we grow.

  • Keep admin and compliance airtight: You will track expenses, make sure invoices are recorded correctly for our accounting team, and partner with Finance and Legal on our compliance routines so nothing falls through the cracks.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 3+ years in Workplace, Office Management, People Operations, Event Management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. You have already owned an office and a set of team rituals end-to-end — you know what it takes to make them impeccable, not just functional.

  • Ownership mindset: You take full ownership of your scope, from strategy down to the smallest detail, and run complex projects from start to finish with little supervision.

  • Attention to detail: You spot what others miss. A crooked frame, a missing supply, a rough onboarding email — none of it gets past you, because you know these details are what people actually feel.

  • Organized and efficient: You are structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at juggling many priorities without dropping any of them. You care about deadlines and you meet them.

  • Interpersonal skills: You build strong relationships across the team and foster a real sense of belonging. People feel comfortable coming to you, and you make them feel taken care of.

  • Confident communicator: You are comfortable engaging with the team every day and speaking in front of large groups when the moment calls for it.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You welcome feedback, you go the extra mile by default, and you are not afraid of taking initiative on topics that were not in your job description.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Job Description


👥 Customer Care at Maki

At Maki, our Customer Care team is the heartbeat of our customer experience helping recruiters and candidates navigate their journey with us. As the first point of contact, you'll play a key role in building trusting relationships between Maki and our clients.

You'll be joining Solène and Roisin, along with our outsourced agents, to provide exceptional support and ensure a seamless experience for our users.

🚀 What you'll do

No two days will be the same! Your responsibilities will include:

  • Problem-solving with empathy – Address the most complex customer and candidate tickets that have been escalated from our outsourcing provider.

  • Optimising customer support – Analyse customer interaction data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for service improvement, with strong Excel skills to support the Care team in delivering exceptional support experiences.

  • Creating support materials - Write and refine Help Centre articles that reflect our brand’s tone of voice clear, friendly, and helpful making sure our recruiters and candidates feel supported and empowered at every step of their journey.

  • Engaging with teams - Stay on the ball through communicating daily with other teams in the company as well as external collaborators, such as our outsourcing provider.

Beyond day-to-day tasks, you will be asked to contribute to the future of MakiPeople in this AI-era and work on building and deploying AI-driven customer support agents.



What we are looking for ?

✅ Must-haves

  • Strong passion for AI and HR tech

  • Strong analytical mindset – able to interpret data and make strategic decisions

  • Proactive & innovative – excited to tackle challenges with creative solutions

  • Exceptional customer service & communication skills – able to build strong relationships

  • Excellent writing skills

  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Excel

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

  • Either native French or English speaker;

    and C1 proficiency in French or English too.

🌟 Nice-to-haves

  • Experience working with AI-driven tools

  • Fluency in additional languages

  • Experience with our tools: Intercom, Slack and Notion

A note on diversity @MakiPeople

“Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.”

🌱 Your progression with us

  • Make a Real Impact: As part of our small, dynamic team, your contributions will have a direct and visible impact on the company’s success. Your work truly matters here.

  • Unlock Career Growth: With plenty of learning and development opportunities, this is your chance to grow your career in autonomy, problem-solving, process design, innovation, and client management.

  • Ambitious Futures Welcome: We value ambition and are excited to support your journey toward more senior roles as you grow and as new opportunities emerge within the company.

  • Shape Your Path: We are committed to supporting your career evolution, offering flexible “transversal” mobility opportunities tailored to your aspirations and goals within the organisation.

💝 Your benefits

  • 🤩 A competitive intern salary

  • 📍 A flexible working policy (hybrid, full-remote (if permitted by school))

  • 🍽️ A lunch card with a dedicated monthly budget

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👧 Team socials (weekly lunch & drinks, quarterly MakiDays)

  • 🏠 Morning offices located in Silicon IX, if based in Paris

  • 👪 A supportive working environment

✨ Join us at Maki

Our vision 🔭

Give human resources more-than-human powers.

Our mission 🎯

Build the conversational AI agent that liberates HR teams, advances organizations, and expands human potential.

Our values 🎨

We are still very young and our culture is evolving as we grow together. Nonetheless, below are values we identify ourselves with:

  • Play to Win - Our ambition is limitless. We relentlessly aim for the top, pushing forward to be number one.

  • Push the Boundaries - Innovation drives us. We adapt, evolve, and set new standards to redefine whatʼs possible.

  • Trust is Earned - Trust is our foundation. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of transparency, security, and responsibility.

  • Embrace Intensity - Speed and precision define our approach. We execute with urgency, focus, and purpose to create immediate, tangible impact.

  • Stronger together - We succeed as one. Collaboration, shared purpose, and collective ownership are at the heart of our progress.

    What's next ?


    We want to offer the best candidate experience possible by letting everyone apply, ensuring that the process lasts ~3 weeks from the moment you get invited to the first step.

    Step 1: An assessment on Maki (~20mins) 💡

    This is to answer some preliminary admin questions and some activities to test your skills for this role.

    Step 2: An interview with Roisin (~30mins) 🤝🏼

    If we believe you may be a good match, we’ll arrange a first call (in English) with Roisin, to cover: your experience, your vision of the role and your interest in joining us.

    Step 3: An interview with Solène (~30mins) 👀

    This interview (in French) with Solène will give you the opportunity to express your motivations further, let your skills shine and ask any last questions you might have about the the team, company or role!

    Step 4: A take home case study

    You will be asked to write a Help Centre article, carry out a short data analysis and do a French language test.

    Step 5 : Your offer 💌

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

VOTRE RÔLE 

Le/la Responsable Chef de produit Chaîne & Trame Femme est en charge du développement des catégories C&T, Denim et Cuir. Il/Elle est en lien avec la direction créative et assure le développement des collections dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais.

Le poste combine une forte implication opérationnelle sur le développement produit ainsi que le management de 2 chefs de produit et d’une alternante.

VOS MISSIONS 

  • Produit : piloter le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme (incl. denim et cuir) du brief à la normalisation. Assurer la mise au point des produits (du 1er prototype au SMS) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et la cohérence produit. Sécuriser la faisabilité industrielle tout en proposant des ajustements adaptés.
  • Coûts : contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations si nécessaire.
  • Suivi & coordination : piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien avec les différents intervenants (studio, tissus et fournitures, merchandising, atelier et production), et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des différents jalons de développement.
  • Management : encadrer 3 ressources, organiser les priorités, accompagner le suivi des développements et garantir la bonne tenue du périmètre.

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Solide expérience en développement chaîne & trame femme, incluant denim et cuir.
  • Excellente compréhension des process industriels, de la mise au point produit et des exigences qualité.
  • Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément dans un environnement créatif et exigeant.
  • Rigueur, sens du détail, autonomie et forte capacité d’adaptation.
  • Aisance dans la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.
  • Première expérience réussie en encadrement ou forte appétence pour le management.

Le poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris.

Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

C'est quoi l'équipe Produit Poker ? 

Notre mission est de concevoir et faire évoluer l'expérience poker chez Winamax. Nous définissons la roadmap produit, aussi bien pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités (Reveal, Moods, Shots, Winamax Legends...) que pour les grands projets structurants de l'application (refonte des lobbys, nouveaux parcours utilisateurs, nouvelles variantes de jeu, etc.).

A PROPOS DU POSTE

Ton grand défi sera d'imaginer une solution innovante pour améliorer l'expérience des nouveaux joueurs. Un objectif ambitieux que tu concrétiseras grâce à l'apprentissage progressif de notre métier et de nos méthodes.

Ce que tu vas apprendre : 

L'un de nos principaux enjeux est de lever les barrières à l'entrée et de proposer une expérience utilisateur fluide et engageante, capable de renforcer l'attractivité de notre application et de maximiser la rétention des nouveaux utilisateurs.

Dès ton arrivée, tu seras pleinement intégré aux réflexions menées sur les projets les plus stratégiques de l'équipe (refonte de parties de l'application, nouvelles fonctionnalités, nouveaux parcours joueurs...). Au fil du stage, tu seras progressivement associé à leur conception et gagneras en autonomie dans leur pilotage.

  • Participer aux réflexions autour de la roadmap produit 
  • Suivre le développement avec les équipes techniques 
  • Participer aux recettes et à la validation d'un projet avant son lancement 
  • Découvrir toutes les étapes de conception d'un produit digital, de l'idée jusqu'à sa mise entre les mains de plusieurs centaines de milliers de joueurs.
 

Ce que tu vas accomplir :

Au fil du stage, tu seras donc progressivement intégré au processus de définition et de pilotage de nos projets produits. Cette montée en compétence te conduira à ton projet de fin de stage : repenser et optimiser l'expérience d'accueil et d'intégration du nouveau joueur.

Ton objectif : t'appuyer sur l'identification des barrières à l'entrée et l'analyse des faiblesses de notre application pour concevoir, en collaboration avec un UI/UX Designer, une solution capable d'augmenter durablement la rétention des nouveaux joueurs sur notre application.

et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études avec de vraies responsabilités.

About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Yuzu is building a portfolio of real money gaming apps, combining accessible mobile gameplay with competition and real cash prizes. We’re currently developing our first games, with the ambition to launch and grow several apps.
We’re a small team working across product, creative production and growth, using AI to prototype ideas, create content and test quickly. Joining Yuzu means getting involved before launch, taking ownership of projects and helping shape both the games we build and the way we work.

Role

You will work closely with the team building the product and launching the business. You will contribute across creative production, AI workflows and early growth, with room to suggest ideas and take them through to execution.
Your role is to turn ideas into things we can use and test: creative assets, playable prototypes, useful workflows and experiments that help us move towards launch.

  • Produce creative content. Develop concepts and create videos, visuals, animations and gameplay content for our marketing. Take an idea from a first draft to an asset we can put in front of users.

  • Build systems with AI. Turn repetitive work into practical workflows for research, content production and testing. Create reusable templates and lightweight automations, and check the quality of the outputs.

  • Benchmark widely. Explore competing games and relevant consumer apps. Study their creatives, onboarding, gameplay and reward systems, then turn your observations into ideas we can try.

  • Prototype interactive experiences. Use AI, no-code or coding tools to build demos, small game concepts and playable ads. Learn the tools needed to get a first version working.

  • Run frequent experiments. Quickly test different creative angles, formats and interactions. Be clear about what you want to learn, review the results and recommend what to try next.

  • Help get the business ready to launch. Produce and organise launch assets and materials, spot gaps and pick up practical tasks with the team. Follow through until they are done.

 

Profile

  • You are a final-year student or recent graduate, ideally from an engineering school or a leading business school. You learn quickly, enjoy unfamiliar problems and want to help launch a new business in real money gaming.

  • You build things on your own. You have side projects to show: a small product, a website, a content project, a game prototype or an automation. You can explain what you made and how you approached it.

  • You are comfortable working with AI. You already use AI to research, create and solve practical problems. You enjoy combining tools into repeatable workflows and improving how work gets done.

  • You have a knack for content. Experience with image and video generation, editing tools, AI coding assistants, no-code workflows or simple scripting will be useful. A good visual eye and an interest in consumer products will also help.

  • You are curious and analytical. You like exploring products, comparing approaches and testing ideas. You can break down a problem, identify a useful first experiment and explain what you learned.

  • You take initiative and follow through. You are comfortable switching between creative, technical and business tasks. You can make progress independently, ask for feedback and flag blockers early.

  • You work well in French and English. You speak fluent French and have strong written and spoken English. You can communicate your ideas clearly and research unfamiliar topics independently.

Nice to have: You have a feel for games. You explore new games and notice what makes a mechanic satisfying or an experience engaging. Card games, tournament formats and risk-and-reward mechanics are familiar territory.

We will value your ability to learn, choose the right tools and deliver work that we can use.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience, plus bonus

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family, 100% covered by Voodoo

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Security Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

  • Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

  • Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

  • Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

  • Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us:

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

  • An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

  • Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

  • Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

  • A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

  • A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.


What you bring along:

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

  • 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

  • Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

  • UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

  • Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

  • Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to have:

  • Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

  • Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

data.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

data.description:
Über Jurata

Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen.

Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Rolle

KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding.

Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine.

  • Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft.

  • Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis.

  • Du begleitest Neukundinnen und Neukunden beim Onboarding, damit der Legal Agent schnell Teil ihres Alltags wird.

  • Du bist an Events, Fachanlässen und Hochschulen das Gesicht von Jurata.

  • Du pflegst deine Sales-Pipeline und unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und zuverlässig.

  • Du bringst Kundenfeedback und Einwände strukturiert ins Team ein und gestaltest so Produkt und Playbook direkt mit.

Was du mitbringst

Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis.

  • Du studierst Rechtswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master) und kannst dich mit einem Pensum von 40–80 % engagieren.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Es reizt dich, juristische Fachpersonen von technologischer Innovation zu überzeugen.

  • Du interessierst dich für Legal Tech, KI und Sales und greifst ohne Scheu zum Telefon.

  • Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe: Du bleibst dran und lernst daraus.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.

  • Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch verständigen. Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Legal AI an vorderster Front: Du arbeitest in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Start-ups der Schweiz, mit einem Produkt, das bereits täglich in der Praxis im Einsatz ist.

  • Netzwerk in der Rechtsbranche: Du lernst Kanzleipartner, General Counsels und Rechtsabteilungen kennen, lange vor deinem Berufseinstieg.

  • Bewährtes Setup: Playbooks, qualifizierte Anfragen und regelmässiges Coaching machen dich schnell selbstständig.

  • Fixum plus Provision ohne Obergrenze: Du erhältst ein Fixum und dazu eine Erfolgsprovision, die nach oben nicht begrenzt ist. Die angegebene Vergütungsspanne umfasst Fixum und Erfolgsprovision.

  • Flexibles Pensum: Innerhalb von 40–80 % richtet sich dein Pensum nach Vorlesungen und Prüfungen, nicht umgekehrt.

  • Praxiserfahrung, die zählt: Du erlebst aus erster Hand, wie KI die juristische Arbeit verändert, und baust Sales-Skills auf, die dir in jeder Karriere Vorteile bringen werden.

  • 25 Ferientage: Du hast 25 Ferientage pro Jahr, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Remote-Woche: Du arbeitest bei uns im Büro in Zürich. Nach der Probezeit hast du Anrecht auf eine Woche Remote Work pro Jahr.

  • Fitness-Abo: Du erhältst ein kostenloses Abo für das Fitnessstudio direkt neben unserem Büro.

  • Firmenlaptop: Du erhältst von uns einen Firmenlaptop.

  • Teamkultur: Wir pflegen eine echte Start-up-Kultur, haben einen legendären Teamgeist und unterstützen uns jederzeit gegenseitig. Es gibt kostenlose Snacks und Getränke, regelmässige Teamevents, (freiwillige) gemeinsame Workouts und eine lockere Kleiderordnung.

So bewirbst du dich

Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinen universitären Leistungsausweisen, weiteren (Arbeits-)Zeugnissen und ein paar Sätzen zu deiner Motivation, die du direkt im Bewerbungsformular eingeben kannst. Ein zusätzliches Bewerbungsschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wir melden uns bei Interesse innert weniger Tage für ein unkompliziertes Kennenlernen.

Passt es zeitlich gerade nicht, aber du kennst jemanden, der in Frage kommt? Empfiehl uns die Person per E-Mail an ----- Bei einer erfolgreichen Anstellung schenken wir dir als Dankeschön ein Studenten-Jahresabo für den Jurata Legal Agent.

About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

Wir sind itesys, DEIN synonym für Engineering Excellence.

Wir sind über 200 Technikexpert:innen mit einer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für SAP-Technologie, SAP Security und Platform Engineering – und das seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012. Wir sehen uns als kreative Köpfe und strategische Wegbereiter:innen, als Umsetzer:innen und Optimierer:innen, immer mit einer gehörigen Portion Spirit und Begeisterung. Genau diese Mischung macht uns aus!

Wir kennen die digitalen Herausforderungen unserer Kundschaft und liefern die passenden Lösungen. Dank unseres tiefen Fachwissens und unserem ausgeprägten technischem Weitblick gelingt es uns, die IT-Landschaften unserer Kunden kontinuierlich an die komplexen und sich ständig verändernden Anforderungen anzupassen.

Mit deinem Wissen…

  • konzeptionieren, implementieren, realisieren und betreiben wir komplexe System- und berätst du unsere Kunden umfassend und weitsichtig mit einem hohen Servicegedanken

  • betreust du eigenständig bestehende SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Landschaften und entwickelst diese mit internen und externen Schnittstellen weiter

  • planst, organisierst und setzt du technische Projekte im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld um

  • leitest du die Implementierung und den Rollout von Schnittstellen in Kundensystemen, einschliesslich der Migration von SAP PI/PO auf die SAP Integration Suite

  • führst du Performance Analysen durch und berätst unsere Kunden bei Architekturfragen und deren technischer Formulierung, auch im Hinblick auf die strategische Weiterentwicklung Richtung SAP Integration Suite

Das gelingt dir durch...

  • Berufserfahrung im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld und mehrere erfolgreich realisierte Projekte in diesen Bereichen

  • sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares)

  • fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich SAP Software Architektur sowie Erfahrungen mit Integrationstechnologien wie z.B. Webservices/XML/SOAP/REST/OData

  • eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten

  • Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder?

Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten:

Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell: Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen.

Weiterbildung: Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem

Zukunftsorientierung: Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft.

Tools: Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen.

Teamspirit: Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen.

Come as you are!: Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are!

Mehr Ferientage: Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut!

Workation & Entsendungen: Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende.

Work-Life-Balance: Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance.

Wellbeing: Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten.

Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten?

Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht.

Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur.

Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder?

Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen.

Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse.

Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor

Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

As a consultant, you will have to support our clients in the realization of their projects on site by bringing your expertise and your skills.

You are agile and eager to adapt to different work environments that will fuel your curiosity of seeing what’s behind closed doors of the biggest projects of our client’s portfolio.

Tasks

You will work on the design, implementation, qualification and improvement of automation systems in GMP-regulated environments. Depending on your background, your expertise may focus on PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES or industrial networks.

You will collaborate with engineering, production, quality and validation teams on complex investment and improvement projects.

Your responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement automation solutions in GMP environments.
  • Contribute to the configuration and programming of PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS or MES systems.
  • Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot automation, control and communication issues.
  • Develop and improve automation standards, procedures and technical documentation.
  • Support batch control, recipe management, data integrity and process monitoring activities.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the delivery of strategic pharmaceutical and biotech projects.

Requirements

  • Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial IT or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life science environment.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES, industrial automation or OT networks.
  • Knowledge of automation systems and industrial communication technologies.Experience with one or more platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Emerson DeltaV or Syncade is an advantage.
  • Understanding of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity and qualification/validation principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a consulting and project-based environment.
  • Good communication skills in English; German is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Joining a group with strong development potential that aims to improve your employability on challenging and varied projects

  • Joining a structure that has been established in Switzerland for a long time with a client portfolio that includes leaders in the sector
  • Having a sustainable job with stability and access to a real collaboration
  • Benefit from training with accredited and certified centers
  • Having a local management team to support you in the achievement of your missions and in the development of your career
  • Being part of a dynamic, committed team with real human values that we live by every day

Only applications from Swiss and EU citizens will be considered.
